title: Sophie Casterwill
summary: Sophie Casterwill is a daughter of the noble Casterwill family order, who was orphaned as a young girl following a fire at her parents' home. A brilliant student who loves reading, Sophie has a deep knowledge of ancient history, and an excellent memory for myths and legends. Pulled into a life of adventuring with the Huntik Foundation after she forged an alliance with her classmate, Lok Lambert, Sophie's ability to master complex and ancient magic is invaluable to their team in their fight against evil. When talking gets nowhere, Sophie Casterwill can rely on powerful Casterwill family magic along with Sabriel, an elegant Titan that favors speed over brawn.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
after the destruction of her home]]
Sophie Casterwill was born into the mysterious Casterwill family and, as such, is one of the descendants of the first Seeker, Lord Casterwill. [Huntik.com/Profiles] As a young girl, her parents were killed at their home in Paris by the Blood Spiral arsonist, Kiel. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] She was rescued by her bodyguard Santiago who brought her to a Casterwill warehouse where she was raised by the caretaker LeBlanche. [Sophie on Trial] [Huntik.com/Profiles]

They eventually moved to Venice where she attended attended Venice Preparation Academy, though was unaware that she had sat in front of Lok Lambert for three years. While at Lok's dormitory, she and Lok discovered a secret journal belonging to Lok's father, Eathon Lambert. [A Seeker Is Born] Due to Lok's inability to pay, Sophie used some of her family fortune to hire Dante Vale of the Huntik Foundation to investigate the disappearance of Lok's father, Eathon, and to train herself and Lok as part of the Foundation. [The Casterwill Client]

When the Prague Huntik Hotel was attacked by the Organization's Suits, the team was joined by Zhalia Moon, of whom Sophie became suspicious. When the team follows a clue from Eathon Lambert's journal about Metagolem, Sophie helped them to gain access to Jodis Lore's tomb by smearing clay on the tombstone and inscribing the symbol for truth. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

When the team decided to take a vacation at at the Lambert family's house, meeting Scarlet Byrne caused Sophie to become jealous. As they joined Scarlet on a mission to the New Grange Passage Tomb and had to protect Scarlet from the Organization's Suits, Sophie had to work together with Scarlet. [Home Turf]

On a mission to the Castle of Vlad Dracul, Sophie realized Zhalia's betrayal of the team and faced off against her former teammate. Despite her prowess, Sophie was defeated; however, as Zhalia was about to deliver the final blow, Lok leapt in between the two and managed to stop the fight. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

After following a clue about the Ring of Tao from Eathon Lambert's journal to King Solomon's mines in Ethiopia, Sophie and Lok had to dress as King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba and express their true feelings for one another. [To Be Together]

During the final battle against the Professor, Sophie suffered a great loss when her loyal Titan and lifelong friend Sabriel sacrificed herself to protect Sophie against the Professor's Titans, resulting in her Amulet being destroyed. [The Mission] As a result, following the Professor's defeat, for a time, Sophie felt weak and useless to the team, particularly due to being unable to hold her own against Wilder and his team on several occasions. [Doorway to Huntik] [The Tower of Nostradamus] However, in the Crystal Caves, Sophie found her strength when Sabriel returned to her through Powerbonding and she recovered the Amulet of her sister, Sorcerel. Here, Sophie also discovered that she was a direct descendant of the original Lord Casterwill. [Cave of the Casterwills] 

After recovering the Willblade from Avalon, the team attempted to research it at the Casterwill Library. However they were attacked by three Seekers, one of whom was revealed to be Lucas Casterwill, Sophie's brother whom she had believed to be dead. Initially conflicting with one another, Sophie proved herself to Lucas by recovering the location of Void from The Organization. [Chasing Void]

Whilst trying to recover Medusa on Medusa's Island, Sophie was horrified to come face to face with Kiel, the man who burnt her home and killed her parents so many years ago. [Zhalia's Mission] Due to her fear of fire and traumatic memories of Kiel, Sophie was unable to stand up to him, until, finally, after bonding with the Legendary Titan of Valor, Mythras and inspired by the sacrifice of Nimue Casterwill, Sophie managed to find the courage to defeat him, avenging her past and taking control of her future with leadership of the Casterwill family. [The Spiral War]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.text:
Sophie is a book-smart, athletic, honorable, and clever young lady of about Lok's age. She acts quite proper and mature due to her status as a member of the Casterwill family, and she thus has a lot of confidence in her own skills and fighting abilities, which she isn't afraid to put to use. [Huntik.com/Profiles] She is usually one of the first to provide criticism, sometimes unfairly, and has a competitive streak, disliking finishing after someone else, such as when Lok managed to beat her at a puzzle prior to their mission to find King Basilisk's Amulet. [Absent Heroes]

Despite her sometimes egotistical personality, she is compassionate towards her teammates and included Lok in the deal she made when hiring Dante Vale. [The Casterwill Client] She even expressed concern that Zhalia would demean herself as a part of her rationale to betray the team for her adoptive father, Klaus. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

Sophie was deeply affected by the loss of Sabriel, which led her to feel weak and useless to the team. [Cave of the Casterwills] Her confidence also began to falter upon encountering other, powerful members of the Casterwill family, particularly her lost brother Lucas, who didn't put trust in her abilities at all. [Chasing Void] After mastering the Legendary Titan of Valor, Mythras, and playing a pivotal role in stopping the Blood Spiral's assault at the Fortress of Iron Will, she regained her confidence. [The Spiral War]

Sophie also confronted her severe pyrophobia (the fear of fire) upon meeting Kiel, a member of the Blood Spiral, and realizing that he was the one who had killed her parents in an arson attempt when she was young. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] She eventually overcame this fear once she bonded with Phoenix, the Legendary Titan of Rebirth, by diving into the heart of a volcano. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
from her hand]]
Sophie is an outstanding spellcaster of magic and utilizes offensive and defensive spells in combat, and is also well-practiced in spells specialized with dealing with traps. She is also a book-learned expert in much of the ancient history of the world of Seekers. As a member of the Casterwill family, she also possesses the innate ability to sense magical energy. [Huntik.com/Profiles] As result of Powerbonding with Sabriel, whose Amulet was destroyed, Sophie is able to uniquely summon her directly from her hand. [Cave of the Casterwills]

Sophie is a skilled fighter, having received thorough training in martial arts since her childhood. [The Treasures of the Argonauts] She trains hard and can handle herself against more than one opponent. [S1E01] She is also has a pilot's license [The Bookshop Hunter], and can play the flute. [S2E41]

sections.heading: Bonded Titans
sections.text:
Albion — TV Series — borrowed — Lent to Sophie by LeBlanche to use against the Professor; she returned Albion to him after the Professor's defeat.

Enfluxion — TV Series — A water Titan gifted to her by Teien to fight Kiel and the Blood Spirals.

Feyone — TV Series — Inherited at a young age as a standard issue Casterwill family Titan, Feyone was one of Sophie's distinctive Titans in her early adventures.

Hoplite — TV Series — Given by Zhalia after recovering a chest of Amulets from the Argo.

Icarus — TV Series — Inherited at a young age as a standard issue Casterwill family Titan, Icarus was one of Sophie's distinctive Titans in her early adventures.

Kelpie — TV Series — An aquatic, horse-like Titan acquired by Sophie prior to the Longest Night of the Year.

Mythras — TV Series — given away — The Legendary Titan of Valour, Sophie bonded with him during the Trial of Courage; she later gave him to Vivian to protect her.

Phoenix — TV Series — The Legendary Titan of Rebirth, Sophie dived into the Phoenix Volcano to recover her Amulet and rise from the ashes.

Sabriel, Powerbonded — TV Series — Sophie's first and Signature Titan, her Amulet was tragically destroyed; A year later, she returned through their Powerbond and is now summoned from Sophie's hand.

Sorcerel, Powerbonded — TV Series — The magic-oriented sister of Sabriel, found in the Crystal Caves; as Sophie felt the pressure to lead her family and avenge her past, they Powerbonded to defeat Kiel.

Grand Dragon Leviathan — comic — The Legendary Titan of the Deeps, Sophie managed to stop it from destroying Venice, using her authority as a Casterwill to call it back to his Amulet.

Triton — comic — The first Triton of Alexandria, Sophie's Triton has a unique red mane and gold armor.

Peque — tcg — This Mayan princess Titan belongs to Sophie.

Megataur — 5d — In Huntik 5D, Sophie rescued a Megataur Titan from a labyrinth after it was chained up by the Dark Guardians.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*According to the [[Huntik.com/Ask Guggenheim|Ask Guggenheim]] portal, Sophie is 15 years old. However, the Seeker Community section in ''[[Huntik Magazine]]'' ([[Grand Dragon Leviathan (Comic)|Issue 9]]) states that she is 16.
*During the early production of the series, Sophie was originally named "Sofia". This appeared as a scripting error in Episode 4 "[[Into the River of Secrets]]" when Dante introduces her as "Sofia" to [[Guggenheim]]. The name means "wisdom" in Greek. 
*The show's artistic director, [[Simone Borselli]], revealed in an interview with ''Vanity Fair'' that Sophie's appearance was inspired by that of the movie actress, [[:wikipedia:Gwyneth Paltrow|Gwyneth Paltrow]]. He has also stated that Sophie was the character he most identified with. {{Extsource|1=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AjYWmvnOqQo&list=PL6NZlSvyFyQU-o6alH6pXfEqPNXEBFSQo|2=YouTube}}
